# Ticket 4581 — "order confirmation emails arrive late"

**Opened:** 2026-08-24 · **Reported by:** support lead

Twelve customers since 2026-08-20 report that the order confirmation email
arrives well after the order is placed. Five forwarded the email; the header
timestamps are 28–34 minutes after the order time shown in the admin panel.

Most orders are unaffected — support estimates "maybe one in five" from the
complaints and from spot-checking recent orders. No customer reports a *missing*
email, only a late one. Nothing changed in the email templates.
